title: Class-II source, translated model, balanced coefficient jets, and obstruction boundary
statement: R-098 proves that the R-097 posterior bracket is superadditive only under a matching row/payment split and that the production rational rank-one row is exactly a conditional ridge deficit. Its standalone R-085 (6.5) recovery identity retains the low endpoint, actual Cameron--Martin matrix payment, and an upper-form requirement for the five unshifted families. An exact production-coefficient fibre has negative rational ridge deficit but is not a torus/control counterexample. For two opposite subvisits refining one source-block secant and sharing the same fixed target heat and root derivative, each Cartan far square has order A^2 while the mixed energy--terminal-sextic payload has order A; the signed atoms cancel exactly before squaring. Thus only refinement-stable nonnegative per-subvisit atomization is retired. Distinct temporal roots/heats, a once-only pure-X payment, and the regular one-shot class are not covered. Derivative-free resampling supplies a bare 2^(-3k) Hardy mass but not a once-only ANOVA ledger. The signed grouped production posterior form, Cartan one-use (4.11), rational shifted-Hessian form (6.5), complete H_N, REG, progressive/revisit H_A, OVERLAP_src, q=10/9 Nelson, floor removal, measure construction, and Sector A remain open. Tier stays T4.

R-092 closes only the R-079 regular mutually orthogonal strict-past no-revisit one-shot H_C class. R-093 adds the augmented perspective, paid cutoff-two, information, and source-union boundary. R-094 adds the regular centered Gram-secant theorem, fresh derivative form, value-heat control-prefix payment, exact fractional square ledger, BG critical-row audit, and absolute revisit-summation no-go. R-095 adds the exact moving-prefix defect, fractional matrix-perspective Loewner criterion, conditional resolvent-gap and transformed-mean ownership, critical absolute theta_j schedule audit, and near-root T_G Cartan homotopy/regular-FAR projector separation. R-096 proves complete-cancellation-first ordering, exact product/Doob covariance ownership, predictable-baseline genuine large-gap support collapse after a fixed payable collar, coordinate low-Hermite Wick compression, and full-square q/r ownership.
